text:
Alex: Morning — quick heads up. I'm running late for a 30m meeting that just popped up; I'll cover primary duties until 09:25PT but I need Priya to take non-sev1 pages while I'm briefly in the meeting. If anything looks customer-impacting page Jon immediately.

OncallBot: [alert] S2 tokenization-worker error rate spike (alert_id: 9832) — firing at 09:12PT.

Alex: Routing note — temporarily shift non-sev1 alerts to secondary only while I'm in the meeting. I pushed a temp rule via rotationctl, will revert when I'm back.

Alex: Config snippet I used:
```
rotationctl set-temp-routing --from=primary --to=secondary --duration=30m --filter="!sev1"
```

Priya: Acked, taking non-sev1. If a Sev1 appears I'll page Jon + Maria and drop a short note in #incidents with estimated impact. Confirmed runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/llm-serving-timeouts (use the "tokenizer" section).

Jon: If Sev1 lands — page me and Maria immediately. Quick triage commands: first check pods, then tail logs.
```
kubectl -n llm get pods -l app=tokenizer -o wide
kubectl -n llm logs -f deploy/tokenizer --since=10m
```

Nikhil: FYI network team: if you see >30% connection-refused across hosts treat as infra and page infra-oncall. Escalation schedule we agreed: Sev1 = 3min ack window, Sev2 = 5min. If no ack escalate to manager.

Alex: I've shortened the ack window for Sev1 in PagerDuty to 3m for this window. Priya — when you ack please add the tag `primary-cover` and one-line reason so we can audit handoff.

Priya: :thumbsup: Acked and watching logs now. Tokenizer error spike coincided with a canary. If errors don't drop I'll pause routing to v2.

OncallBot: DeployBot: canary deploy tokenizer v2.1 completed at 09:10PT; monitoring window 20m.

Priya: Noted — canary may be correlated with the spike. I'll hold traffic to v2 if rates keep climbing.

Jon: If we need to roll back the canary: 
```
kubectl -n llm rollout undo deploy/tokenizer --to-revision=1
```

Alex: Final checklist before I step into the meeting: 1) Priya is temporary primary for non-sev1, 2) Jon/Maria = escalation for Sev1, 3) Nikhil/infra-oncall = infra escalations, 4) Pager duty ack windows shortened. Contact list below. I'm leaving channel at 09:25PT but reachable by DM for criticals.

Contacts: Jon (SRE lead) - @jon, Maria (SRE manager) - @maria, Nikhil (infra) - @nikhil, infra-oncall (pager) - +1-555-0100, Rotation tool: rotationctl docs internal.

Alex: Leaving now — ping me if anything breaks. - Alex
